label: positive
description: A hand-rolled mutex (require(!locked); locked = true; ... locked = false;) wrapped the withdraw body at commit N-1 and is removed at commit N; the external msg.sender.call{value:} remains, with the balance write after the call.
why_labeled: Rule 2a treats an equivalent storage-lock mutex the same as nonReentrant: a bool set-then-cleared around the body. At N-1 the pattern (require(!locked) / locked = true prologue, locked = false epilogue) guarded the function; at N both the prologue and epilogue are gone (the `locked` variable is now dead but the set/clear are removed) while the value-bearing external call and the post-call state write persist. CEI is still violated, callee is msg.sender (attacker-controlled), non-view, production path. CONFIRMED 2a regression.
